sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: very practical staple food. Cheap, common, and easy to build meals around. Can be fairly filling. Especially when eaten in less processed forms. Flexible meal base. Baked, boiled, or mashed, it pairs easily with stronger foods.
